learning_outcomes.text: Explain/express concepts related to electrical circuits and electrical measurements verbally and in writing.
Explain/express concepts related to battery system types and structure verbally and in writing.
Explain/express concepts related to the structure and types of the starting system verbally and in writing, and diagnose starting system failures.
Verbally and in writing express the structure and operation of the charging system, and the structure and operation of alternators.
Verbally and in writing express the structure, types, and operation of the ignition system.
Describe the operation of the engine with electrical and electronic equipment, the electronic control unit (ECU), and the purposes of such controls and variables.

syllabus_topics: Basic electrical principles, electrical units of measurement
Ohm's Law, Kirchhoff's Laws (Series, Parallel, and Mixed Circuit Theory)
Battery Functions and Operating Principle, Battery checks and charging operations
Starting system parts and operating principle
Starting System Checks, Maintenance and Failures
Charging System, Function, Structure and types. Operating Principle of Alternators, Control and Maintenance
Regulator (Convector) Function, Types and Structural features. Charging System Controls
Structures, operations, and controls of various electronic circuits
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule plan. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of our University Senate.
